newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Sandoz to buy Azupharma from Gehe.
newsitem.headline: Sandoz to buy Azupharma from Gehe.

text.p: Sandoz AG said it plans to acquire Azupharma GmbH, Germany's third largest generics company, from Gehe AG for 640 million marks.
Azupharma, located in Gerlingen near Stuttgart, employs 440 people and generated sales of 222 million marks in 1995.
Sandoz said it is not currently in the German generics market, which is the second largest in the world.

"We intend to expand our position as a leading player in generics, to serve large customers with a full product range and to maximise the life-cycle management of out mature products," Sandoz said in a statement. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
